overview_description.description: BrainKey develops an AI‑based platform that analyzes MRI brain scans and other biomarkers to assess brain health and longevity. The platform offers interactive 3D visualizations of brain structures, tracks changes over time, and provides recommendations tied to nutrition, exercise, and lifestyle. It supports users in monitoring brain age and integrating imaging data with personalized insights.

about_short_description.short_description: BrainKey develops an AI‑based platform that analyzes MRI brain scans and other biomarkers to assess brain health and longevity.

product.name: Brain Scan Data Analysis
product.description: Analyzes MRI brain scans to quantify brain health and longevity, providing 3D visualizations and brain volume measurements.

product.name: Genetic Data Analysis
product.description: Analyzes genetic data from consumer DNA tests to assess genetic factors influencing brain longevity and health.

product.name: BrainAge Calculation
product.description: Calculates an estimated brain age by comparing brain imaging data with neuroscience research to assess brain aging relative to chronological age.

product.name: Personalized Brain Health Recommendations
product.description: Provides individualized recommendations for nutrition, exercise, and lifestyle based on brain imaging and genetic data analysis.
